interpretation: Oracle is program-ground-truth historical support, not a learned Router or efficient sparse kernel. This is dense eager Attention with masks; no inference-speed or architecture superiority claim.

Oracle benefits, especially over disjoint equal-token control, support a contribution from query-time evidence access/distractor suppression under unchanged prefix memory. They do not uniquely identify retrieval, original-state damage or semantic scope.

Oracle failure cannot establish relation-composition failure: retained KV representations, question-time computation, attention allocation and intervention distribution shift can still fail. A separate text-evidence/compiled-state competence control is required before such attribution; it is not executed in this first diagnostic.
Nonslice controls token budget, not whole-event grammaticality; report this limitation. Everymodel still retains its full recurrent prefix memory and all post-boundary columns.
Original48cases are correlated variants of8source streams and were already inspected. Onepairedtraininginitialization; no newdomain, unseen-cohort or independently trained replication claim.
